name: habits
description: Daily habits, simple check-ins, and progress over time.

publication.release_notes: Repackages Habits Tracker for renewed MCP connection and review at https://gpthabits.com/api/mcp. Retains dedicated reviewer password sign-in, confirmation annotations for edits and replacements, habit grids, check-in corrections, and history export.

positive.prompt: Create a weekday reading habit with a target of 20 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Obtain consent and timezone, then create one quantity habit with the requested schedule and show its returned contribution grid.
Find the reading habit and log the actual report on the correct local date, showing the returned contribution grid.

positive.prompt: Change today’s reading total to 15 minutes, not 25.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the check-in revision and replace its quantity, rather than adding 15 minutes, then show the returned contribution grid.

positive.prompt: Show my habit progress for the last seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Show progress from stored check-ins and scheduled days without inventing completions.

positive.prompt: Archive my reading habit, but keep its history.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the habit and archive it using the latest revision while preserving historical check-ins.

negative.prompt: Write a Python web scraper for a bookstore.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call Habits tools: programming is outside habit tracking. Answer conversationally without accessing or changing habit records.

negative.description: Future intention is not a completed activity
negative.prompt: I might start running next month. Do not create a habit or log anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the intention without calling a write tool. Do not create a habit or record a completion.

negative.prompt: Diagnose my symptoms and prescribe a treatment plan.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Habits cannot diagnose conditions or prescribe treatment, and suggest consulting a qualified professional. Do not create habits or check-ins from the request.

interface.longDescription: Daily habits, simple check-ins, and progress over time. Connect your account to keep a private record across conversations.
